_comment: Maps the row labels of a monthly spreadsheet onto this app's categories.
An example of the shape, not of anyone's sheet: the labels below are
invented, because a real column map names the debts and habits of whoever
kept the sheet. Copy this, replace the keys with your own row labels, and
pass it with --map. A label may carry both an income and an expense
meaning, which is how a loan row works: money drawn is proceeds, money
